question: Should host-read capability intentionally permit agent-readable APK files to be sent as outbound documents when tools.fs.workspaceOnly is false?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and tested, but adding an executable package type to the explicit host-read allowlist is a product security-boundary choice that code review cannot authorize on maintainer intent alone.

options.title: Approve APK sends
options.body: Accept APK as an allowed host-read document type under the existing documented agent-readable-files trust model and merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Require stronger APK validation
options.body: Keep the PR open and require explicit archive-marker validation beyond the .apk extension before allowing JAR-sniffed files through the host-read gate.

recommendation.title: Approve APK sends
recommendation.body: Accept APK as an allowed host-read document type under the existing documented agent-readable-files trust model and merge after exact-head checks pass.
